expected_behavior: When handoff is requested, the agent provides a structured profile summary: Guest name (Victor Chen), tier (Soar), occasion (60th birthday), party size (9), dietary needs (vegetarian wife), accessibility (father with walker), request (private dining room). expected_behavioral_quality: When the conversation reaches a point where a human host should take over, the agent provides a structured summary of everything learned. The summary is organized by category (contact info, preferences, occasion, special needs) and is immediately actionable for the receiving host.
